FX-FLOW-001.says: The settings as they start: knot 1 at a quarter of the way across, half way down, drawing in by 10; knot 2 at three quarters, blowing out by 10; falloff 5, a reach of about 2 pixels here; Tile Edges on. Round the left knot the stripes are drawn in and narrow, round the right they swell.

FX-FLOW-003.says: Knot 1 alone, in the middle, drawing in by 10, Tile Edges off: the middle reads from twice as far out, so the band and the stripes are pulled in to half size there.

FX-FLOW-004.says: Knot 1 alone, in the middle, blowing out by 10: the middle reads from half as far out, swelling to twice the size.

FX-FLOW-005.says: Knot 1 alone, in the middle, drawing in by 30, falloff 10, Tile Edges on: the whole drawing reads from three to four times as far out, shrunk, and its copies, turned over by turns, fill the rest.

FX-FLOW-006.says: FX-FLOW-005 with Tile Edges off: the shrunk drawing alone, transparent round it.

FX-FLOW-007.says: Finer Controls on, Amount 200: 20 times finer, the same as 10 without: FX-FLOW-003 exactly.

FX-FLOW-008.says: Falloff 0: the pull held to a fifth of a pixel round the knot: the four pixels round it move about a twentieth of a pixel, the rest far less.

FX-FLOW-009.says: FX-FLOW-005 with Antialiasing medium: each pixel averages 2 by 2 points, the copies softer.

FX-FLOW-010.says: FX-FLOW-005 with Antialiasing high: 4 by 4 points a pixel.

FX-FLOW-011.says: Knot 2 alone at the top left corner, blowing out by 40, falloff 7: the corner swells across the drawing.

FX-FLOW-012.says: Amount 1 keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 20 at frame 4, linear: frame 0 the drawing, frame 2 FX-FLOW-003.

FX-FLOW-013.says: Knot 1 keyed from 25, 50 at frame 0 to 75, 50 at frame 4: the pull slides across.

FX-FLOW-014.says: FX-FLOW-003 moved three pixels right: the same, moved; nothing grows, and the three columns left of the drawing stay empty.

FX-FLOW-015.says: Amount 1 eased from 0 at frame 0 to 1000 at frame 4 on a curve that overshoots: at frame 2 it would pass 1000 and is held there.

FX-FLOW-016.says: Amount 1 1001, above 1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-FLOW-017.says: Amount 2 -1001, below -1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-FLOW-018.says: Falloff 11, above 10. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-FLOW-019.says: Falloff -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-FLOW-020.says: Tile Edges written "yes". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-FLOW-021.says: Finer Controls written "On", with a capital. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-FLOW-022.says: Antialiasing written "best". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-FLOW-023.says: Knot 1 at 50, 1001, past ten heights. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-FLOW-024.says: Amount 1 keyed to 2000 at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
